about: In Eastertide, this pair of Alleluia verses replaces the gradual and tract for Saint Joseph, Spouse of the Blessed Virgin Mary.

seg.tr: Alleluia, alleluia. The Lord loved him and adorned him; He clothed him with a robe of glory. Alleluia. The just man shall spring up like the lily, and shall flourish forever before the Lord. Alleluia.
